item.title: High wind warning Friday, widespread power outages likely
item.description: A powerful low pressure system will move across The Great Lakes and bring very strong, damaging winds to the Miami Valley. A High Wind Warning will be in effect from 5 a.m. to 8 p.m. Friday.
